interactive.reason: Native automated control input and engine captures; no separate hardware-controller or live desktop driving session.

limits: Automated native captures and driving, without a separate manual controller session.
Only Slate Rim has full uninterrupted route coverage; other routes and the loop are not fully driven.
Vehicle reconstructions remain below production racing-game precision.
Short capped GPU samples do not establish long-session stability or identify the cause of whole-PC reboots.
Preset measurements use one stationary quarry view; they are not whole-map performance averages.
Fourteen boundary views cover representative transitions; they do not constitute inspection of every map edge.
Coverage gradients blend materials and traction; the original surface classification still controls tire-mark type and soil deformation.
The stationary GPU fixture freezes the vehicle before suspension settling; ground clearance is verified in the separate live-physics ground tests.
